_doc: 風格實驗：無五官的扁平幾何人物（2026-09-08，參考 Reigns 類卡牌肖像）。id 加 xp_face_ 前綴。用法：python art/scripts/generate_batch.py --manifest art/manifest/experiment_faceless.json --stage flux2 --batch 2

shared.style: STYLE: minimalist flat geometric vector illustration in the manner of card-game character portraits. The face is ONE smooth featureless flat shape with no eyes, no mouth, no nose, no eyebrows, no ears drawn — the only detail on the face is a single straight vertical split down the middle: the left half is lit, the right half is one step darker. Hair, beard, hat, helmet and collar are flat faceted polygon shapes. Clothing uses two or three flat tones. No outlines, no gradients, no texture, no shading other than the two-tone split, hard clean edges, poster-flat.
shared.palette: PALETTE: terracotta #B5442E, deep ochre #8C3A22, banyan green #2F5B3A, ink green #1E4029, jade #5C8A4A, sand #C9A96B, sun-bleached sand #D9C08E, oyster-lime white #E8DCC6, indigo #2C5470, tidal teal #3E7A94, gamboge #E0A93B, cinnabar #A8332B, burnt umber linework #3A2A22.
shared.negative_base: eyes, pupils, mouth, teeth, nose, eyebrows, facial features, realistic face, outline, gradient, texture, shading, photorealism, 3D render

framing.portrait: bust portrait of a single character, head and shoulders, facing the viewer straight on, perfectly symmetrical, centered and filling the frame, isolated on a plain flat dark slate background.
framing.unit: full body game sprite of a single standing character, head to toe fully visible, 3/4 front view, centered, isolated on a plain flat neutral background, standing on nothing — no ground shadow, no shadow ellipse under the feet, no patch of ground, the background is completely empty.

proportions.unit: PROPORTIONS: stylised game character proportions — a noticeably large head, short sturdy body, only 4 head-heights from crown to sole, thick limbs, bold readable silhouette at 128 pixels, simplified hands and face. NOT realistic adult proportions.

assets.name: 無五官實驗：揆一
assets.subject: Frederick Coyett, governor of Dutch Formosa in 1661. Shoulder-length wavy hair and a pointed beard, a black coat with a wide flat white collar forming a square shoulder line. Fair skin tone.

assets.name: 無五官實驗：陳澤
assets.subject: Chen Ze, a Ming loyalist general of Koxinga's army. A Ming helmet with a tall plume, vermillion mountain-pattern lamellar armour with bronze-gold trim at the shoulders, a short dark beard. Medium warm skin tone.

assets.name: 無五官實驗：西拉雅頭目
assets.subject: a Siraya village elder of 17th-century Formosa. Hair tied up in a knot, a shell ear ornament, bare shoulders with a deerskin wrap, holding upright beside the head a rattan staff of office with a silver head. Deep brown skin tone.

assets.name: 無五官實驗：VOC 奴工
assets.subject: an enslaved labourer in the Dutch fort of Formosa, of South Indian or Southeast Asian origin. Short cropped hair, bare shoulders, a plain cloth wrap, a heavy sack strap across one shoulder. Very dark skin tone.

assets.name: 無五官實驗：鄭軍銃卒（全身）
assets.subject: a 17th-century Ming loyalist musketeer of Koxinga's army. East Asian face, clean shaven, hair in a topknot under a conical lacquered iron helmet forming a clear triangular silhouette. A deep terracotta red Ming military tunic, cloth leg wraps, BARE FEET. Holding a matchlock arquebus. The face is a smooth featureless flat shape with only the vertical light/dark split.
assets.pose_text: POSE: walking forward, musket carried low and level at the hip, compact upright silhouette.
